limitations: Worker replacement used two actual current-source builds with a controlled HTTPS static server and the real preview API, not a second Railway deployment.
Compatibility covered the actual historical v4 IndexedDB adapter and v5, including a held old connection. It did not run the whole previous client bundle.
No physical-device, real provider OAuth or live campaign-default mutation acceptance.
Item-bearing migrations intentionally return 409; entry-free version migration and rollback were tested separately.
